title: SR und FK Diagram-Kurve2
description:
Schematic of the wear course of development with graded tolerances (SR) on the evaluation of measurement results. For ease of reference, the corresponding error classes for the qualitative assessment are located.
The tolerance limits in this image reflect the typical profile of a plant life. After the starting the operation (a) takes place in the running-a first wear and the first hardening. The wear of the infrastructure objekt, takes stock of further developments - in the green zone - initially from very little. The system is in a stable condition, and requires only small-scale activities.
From the turning point of the curve (b) the wear increases progressively. Corrective actions are required. The tolerance limit SR100 is also known as economic tolerance, because only economic aspects and the substance of receiving a priority. Pending the achievement of tolerance SRlim (c) the availability (function is not restricted).
From SRlim on, the wear development continues exponentially - which requires a reduction of the dynamic load and increased attention. This will normally ensure a reduction of speed (speedlimit 0.7 x Vmax) and shorter inspection times.

By reaching the threshold of tolerance SRG (d) impairs the security of the facility is - the security line for a possible loss of function is still present - but not definable. At the latest achievement of tolerance with the SRG system is switched off immediately repaired or taking out of operation.
